organize.category.hint: Top-level folders from your bookmarks. Add or remove as you like; the AI prefers reusing these names when naming.
organize.category.fitNote: You chose "Fit into existing folders" - the real structure comes from your bookmarks. This list only hints the AI when naming.
organize.domainStep.hint: These are all bookmark domains. Check the ones you want as standalone directories — the domain's portal page (root/index) is included automatically. Unchecked bookmarks continue to AI classification.
organize.stats.warnThreshold: Most bookmarks did not match any directory closely enough, so nearest-neighbour assignment was used. Lower the assign threshold and retry for a stricter split.
organize.stats.warnVector: Vector dimension mismatch detected (stale model vectors in the index); the similarity threshold was skipped.
organize.stats.warnAi: AI unavailable - directory names came from keywords. Configure a model for more fitting names.
organize.stats.warnAiFailed: A model is configured but the call failed - directory names came from keywords. Check the network and key, then retry.
organize.overflowDir: Created from bookmarks that matched no existing directory

organize.scope.hint: Organizing can be run repeatedly: correctly filed bookmarks stay put, misfiled ones get corrected.
organize.stats.warnNothingToDo: The existing structure already matches: no bookmark needs to move. If everything sits in one folder, switch to "Re-plan the folder structure".
organize.mode.title: Organize Mode
organize.mode.fitHint: Use the current folder structure as the skeleton. Correctly filed bookmarks are left alone, misfiled ones move to a better folder, and only bookmarks that match nothing get a new folder. Safe to re-run.
organize.mode.replanHint: Ignore the existing structure and re-cluster from scratch. Folders change substantially - use when starting over.
organize.scope.globalHint: Organize all bookmarks, including already-filed ones.
organize.domainStep.portalBadgeHint: This domain has a root or index page; when checked, that page is filed together with the rest of the domain.
